content: Local SEO for a small regional org centers on: consistent NAP (name/address/phone) matching everywhere including a Google Business Profile listing, explicit location keywords ('Jujuy', neighborhood/city names) in titles/descriptions/content rather than only generic category terms, and content that ties the club to the local community (events, local mentions) to earn local relevance signals. A Google Business Profile is the single highest-leverage local-SEO asset for a physical club and is out-of-band from the website itself (not a coding task, but should be flagged as a companion action).
